q: 毛泽东在第一师范编入哪个班？
q_en: Which class was Mao Zedong placed in at Hunan First Normal School?
explain: 1914 年第四师范并入一师后，毛泽东编入第八班，1918 年 6 月毕业。
explain_en: After the Fourth Normal School merged into Hunan First Normal in 1914, Mao joined Class Eight and graduated in June 1918.

q: 何叔衡 1913 年入学时年龄多大？
q_en: How old was He Shuheng when he enrolled in 1913?
explain: 他 37 岁入讲习科，是当时年龄最大的学生，也是新民学会最年长的会员。
explain_en: He entered the training course at 37, the oldest student of his cohort and the oldest member of the study society.

q: 毛泽东称哪位老师是「印象最深的教员」？
q_en: Which teacher did Mao call 'the teacher who impressed me most'?
explain: 杨昌济教修身学，初识即赞其「资质俊秀若此」，后来成为毛泽东的岳父。
explain_en: Yang Changji taught self-cultivation, praised Mao's 'fine natural gifts' at first meeting, and later became his father-in-law.

q: 《体育之研究》1917 年发表在哪份刊物上？
q_en: Where was 'A Study of Physical Education' published in 1917?
explain: 1917 年以「二十八画生」笔名发表于《新青年》。
explain_en: It appeared in New Youth in 1917 under the pen name 'Ershibahuasheng'.

q: 毛泽东发表《体育之研究》时使用的笔名是？
q_en: What pen name did Mao use for 'A Study of Physical Education'?
explain: 「二十八画生」是「毛泽东」三个字繁体的笔画数。
explain_en: 'Ershibahuasheng' refers to the 28 strokes of the characters in his name.

q: 新民学会成立于哪一年？
q_en: In which year was the New People's Study Society founded?
explain: 1918 年由毛泽东、蔡和森、萧子升等人发起，是湖南反帝反封建的核心社团。
explain_en: Founded in 1918 by Mao, Cai Hesen and Xiao Zisheng; it was a core anti-imperialist society in Hunan.

q_en: When was the Xiangjiang Review launched?
explain: 1919 年毛泽东在长沙创办《湘江评论》，传播新思想。
explain_en: Mao founded it in Changsha in 1919 to spread new ideas.

q: 新民学会的首任总干事是谁？
q_en: Who was the first secretary-general of the New People's Study Society?
explain: 萧子升任首任总干事，曾与毛泽东徒步游学五县。
explain_en: Xiao Zisheng served as first secretary-general and once walked through five counties with Mao.

q_en: What is the motto of Hunan First Normal School?
explain: 「实事求是」原为一师校训，也是毛泽东思想路线的核心历史源头。
explain_en: 'Seek truth from facts' was the school motto and a core historical source of Mao's line of thinking.

q: 湖南省立第一师范的前身是？
q_en: What was the predecessor of Hunan Provincial First Normal School?
explain: 前身为南宋城南书院，所以有「千年学府、百年师范」之说。
explain_en: Its predecessor was Chengnan Academy of the Southern Song — hence 'a thousand-year academy, a century-old normal school'.

q: 1917 年与毛泽东一起徒步游学的是谁？
q_en: Who walked across the countryside with Mao on the 1917 study tour?
explain: 两人不带分文，徒步五县，读「无字之书」。
explain_en: The two set out penniless and walked through five counties, 'reading the book without words'.

q: 第一个明确提出「中国共产党」名称的是谁？
q_en: Who was the first to put forward the name 'Chinese Communist Party'?
explain: 蔡和森在留法期间提出这一名称，并与毛泽东共同发起新民学会。
explain_en: Cai Hesen proposed the name while in France and co-founded the study society with Mao.

q: 毛泽东在一师坚持冷水浴的地点是？
q_en: Where did Mao take his cold-water baths at the school?
explain: 校内水井是他常年冷水浴的具体地点，四季不断。
explain_en: The campus well was where he bathed in cold water all year round.

q: 徐特立在一师教授哪门学科，且是毛泽东和田汉的老师？
q_en: Which subject did Xu Teli teach at the school, where he taught both Mao and Tian Han?
explain: 徐特立任一师教育学教员，被尊为「延安五老」之一。
explain_en: Xu taught education and is honoured as one of the 'Five Elders of Yan'an'.

q: 毛泽东留下万余字批注的《伦理学原理》是谁授课的教材？
q_en: Whose course used the 'Principles of Ethics' that Mao annotated at length?
explain: 杨昌济讲授伦理学/修身学，毛泽东在该教材上写下一万多字批注。
explain_en: Yang Changji taught ethics and self-cultivation; Mao wrote over ten thousand characters of notes in the textbook.
